description: Defines the FillPolicy enum for view fill behaviors in Android UI designer, including methods for fill preferences and context-based fill checks.

classes.name: FillPolicy
classes.description: Enum representing different fill behaviors for views in Android UI layout, with methods to determine fill preferences based on context and component.

methods.name: fillHorizontally
methods.description: Determines if the view wants to fill horizontally based on the context (vertical or horizontal).

methods.name: fillVertically
methods.description: Determines if the view wants to fill vertically based on the context (vertical or horizontal).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the FillPolicy enum based on a string input.

methods.name: getFillPreference
methods.description: Returns the fill policy preference for a given RadViewComponent, considering palette item and meta model.
